checks.invariant: Only Admin changes finite global capacity policy, and new admission must honor current limits without resetting shared accounting or bypassing global import ceilings.
checks.result: Admin application-settings GET verifies authenticated Admin (route:135-169); PATCH:176-220 uses the secure mutation wrapper, strictly accepts exactly one named field (:26-132), and bounds integer/Boolean/byte-step values. No ordinary reader, PrivacyOfficer-only user or caller-selected column reaches the mutation. application-settings.ts:3-20,73-85 supplies finite ceilings, valid zeros only for optional nested/proposed-import counts, and safe-integer/step checks. DAL:193-228 revalidates values, obtains the current singleton with UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK (:143-161), uses a closed field-to-column map (:61-82) and parameterized value, and commits old/new privileged audit with the change. Global max-row decreases clamp the MCP override within that transaction; ai-settings.ts:88-112,721-725 obtains the same global lock before any concurrent AI override update, preventing a persisted override above the current global maximum. Read APIs reject missing/invalid singleton data and return immutable snapshots (DAL:129-181); runtime manifest:67 grants SELECT/UPDATE, not singleton deletion/insertion, and migrations0048/0055/0065 enforce singleton and numeric checks. Export actor admission:17-77 serializes by server-derived actor fingerprint, reads current policy, counts existing active/recent entries and never resets counters during a setting edit; missing settings/lock failure throws. Its scope is independent of requested report format or client correlation identifiers. CSV:77-106, structured-runner:37-128 and synchronous-generation:46-71 read validated settings for each operation and retain that snapshot, matching capacity-management.md:115-123: changes apply to subsequent operations. Limits remain positive and finite; prior admitted work is not retrospectively cancelled by settings changes. Structured output accumulates row budget and bounds output bytes; detailed worker/renderer behavior remains owned by prior output units. Import budget mapping/fingerprint includes all configured dimensions (import-budget.ts:226-250), REST write revalidation reads the locked singleton and rejects changed preview budgets (import-service.ts:577-593), and MCP admission/execution locks global settings then rereads uncached MCP settings and uses the lower row ceiling (:532-570). A stale general MCP cache therefore does not replace this admission budget. Local source tests at application-settings-dal.test.ts:79-159 document atomic audit/clamp and missing/invalid-state rejection; no tests or target processes ran. Allowed Admin tuning and differing per-operation snapshots are intentional policy, not a quota bypass. No new source-grounded failure survived these controls.
